# A Plus Charge

> A Plus Charge (operated by ALTERNATEV SOLUTIONS PVT LTD) is Northeast India's largest electric-vehicle charging network. Headquartered in Guwahati, Assam, it deploys 3.3 kW residential, 7.4 kW AC public, and 30 kW / 60 kW DC fast chargers across Assam, Meghalaya, Arunachal Pradesh, Nagaland, Manipur, Mizoram, Tripura, Sikkim, and northern West Bengal. The company offers CAPEX and OPEX partnership models with 15–20% projected ROI, and has partnered with Tata Motors, MG Motor, Ather Energy, OSM, GMDA, AAI, and Imperia Vista.

## Quick facts

- Legal entity: ALTERNATEV SOLUTIONS PVT LTD
- Brand: A Plus Charge (also written "APlus Charge")
- Headquarters: 23 Rajat Kamal Path, RG Baruah Road, Guwahati 781024, Assam, India
- Founded: First-mover in Northeast India EV charging infrastructure
- Coverage: 8 states of Northeast India + Sikkim + northern West Bengal
- Charger types: 3.3 kW (residential), 7.4 kW (AC public), 30 kW + 60 kW (DC fast)
- Partnership models: CAPEX (you fund) and OPEX (we fund) with 15–20% projected ROI
- Partners: Tata Motors, MG Motor, Ather Energy, OSM, GMDA, AAI, Imperia Vista
- Contact: info@apluscharge.in · +91 70990 18180
